values.note: 45 RV/trailer sites and 12 walk-to tent sites (T01-T12). A loop: 21 sites with 30-amp, 15 non-electric, listed lengths 30-60 ft (A36 20 ft). B loop: 9 sites with 50-amp, but B1-B7 are listed at 20 ft; only B8 and B9 (40 ft) take a longer rig. One wheeled unit and two tents, or three tents, per site.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A233453 (type, Max Vehicle Length, Electricity Hookup, permitted equipment) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233453 (notice 'One wheeled unit and two tents, or three tents are allowed per campsite'; the description's '54 campsites' is out of date), read 2026-11-09

values.note: Two boat ramps (the north ramp is for registered campers Apr 16 - Sep 30), swim beach, accessible fishing dock, playground. Water and waterborne facilities are off Mar 15 - Apr 15 and Oct 1 - Nov 30.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233453 (Facilities: 'Flush toilets, showers, drinking water and a dump station are provided'; amenities Vault Toilets, Boat Ramp, Playground; notices on the north ramp and on reduced amenities), read 2026-11-09

values.note: The recreation.gov description says open year round. Reservations run Mar 15 - Nov 30 only; call the project office (417-276-3113) in the off season.

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233453 (Facilities: 'Cedar Ridge Park is open year round'; notice 'Please call the project office (417-276-3113) for more information during the off season'), read 2026-11-09

values.note: Overnight camping only, with no day use. Check-in and check-out 4 p.m. 14 nights in any 30 days.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233453 (rules maxStay 14 nights rolling 30 days, minHolidayWeekendStay 0; notices on 4:00 PM check-in/out and overnight-only) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/233453/month (no campsite data Dec - Mar 14; bookable 03-15 through 11-30), read 2026-11-09

note: USACE campground on Stockton Lake near Bona. Site A07 sits about 40 m above the riprap shore with the lake in view through scattered oaks; the other shoreline sites (A10, A15, A18, A20, A22) are 50-70 m back in the woods with only glimpses of the water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed from rec.gov: 57 sites (45 RV + 12 walk-to tent; stored 54 = old description), 50-amp at B1-B9 (only B8/B9 fit a 23-ft rig; B1-B7 listed 20 ft), 30-amp at 21 A sites, no water/sewer listed. Fees $10-32 kept, with peak/off-peak spans written. Year-round season kept (description), booking season Mar 15 - Nov 30 written, 14 nights. Lakeview kept on A07 (site photo shows the lake; pad ~40 m from shore through open oaks). Phone 417-995-2045 to add; pin is the rec.gov facility point by the gatehouse, ~300 m S of the loops - move.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview, kept on A07 only). The leaf-off 0.14 m/px frame puts A07's pad ~40 m from the water's edge, across a thinly treed, brushy slope and riprap with no road between. The rec.gov A07 photo (leaf-on, 2020) shows the lake plainly from the pad between scattered oaks. A10 (~68 m), A15/A18 (~55 m), A20 (~50 m) and A22 sit in full woods; their photos show only glimpses through trunks. The B loop and tent loop T face a cove: the tent sites are on its shore but tent-only; B1-B9 sit behind the paved lot/road. Note 'several sites on the lake shore' corrected.
PIN: stored 37.5756,-93.6814 = the rec.gov facility point, by the gatehouse on the entrance road ~300 m S of the A loop. Suggest moving to the A-loop centre at 37.5785,-93.6824.
PHONE: rec.gov lists 417-995-2045 (off season: project office 417-276-3113). The entry has no phone; apply.py doesn't write it, so add it by hand.

FIT: B1-B7 (the only 50-amp sites besides B8/B9) are listed at a 20-ft max vehicle length, and A36 is too. The other 30-amp and non-electric A sites list 30-60 ft. electric 50 stays true because B8 and B9 (40 ft) fit.
WATER HOOKUP not written: no site lists one (19 list 'No', the rest are silent).

SEASON: rec.gov description 'open year round' vs the calendar, which has no campsite data Dec 1 - Mar 14. The off-season-call notice suggests the park stays open without reservations, so year_round is kept and the reservation window goes in booking.season. AWH to confirm if winter camping matters.
